<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the typical methyl region (≈10–30 ppm) are at 31.31, 28.70, 27.60, 22.65, 18.60, and 14.05 ppm. These correspond to six distinct methyl carbon environments, indicating six methyl (CH₃) groups in the molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
